svg.title: Quality manager — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as quality manager, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: A quality-control plot has upper and lower limits with a measured trace between them. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a tapered face.
